text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
1,600m...
It's the same as the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Back then, my body felt impossibly light.
Like it wasn't me, but someone else running.
That's what it felt like...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Still, surely... right now,
I can show what my true strength really is.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (I've been working hard together with Trainer to master using my body properly. If I can just show that on the track...!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I'm going to run even better than back then.
And then...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (I'll show Trainer that their own future can expand too...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I headed toward the paddock
with Nishino Flower, who had finished changing—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You're right...
I was almost about to get in their way.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I need to focus too. It's 1600m;
if I'm distracted, I won't be able to use my body properly."
